title: FireFish v0.4b — open-source microcontroller for underwater photogrammetry
description:
FireFish is a compact, open-source microcontroller board (ATSAMD51J19A) that gives divers real-time depth/altitude feedback, drives a dual-channel camera intervalometer, and logs time-stamped sensor data — inside a standard 2″ underwater housing. This archive is the design-file deposit for board revision v0.4b, and contains the KiCad hardware design (schematic, PCB, Gerbers, BOM), the Arduino board-support package and example firmware, the UF2 bootloader board configuration, and the 3D-printable enclosure carriers.

Licensed by part: hardware (KiCad, Gerbers, STLs, BOM) under CERN-OHL-S v2; original software/firmware under MIT; documentation and figures under CC BY 4.0. Bundled third-party firmware retains its upstream licenses.

Described in the accompanying HardwareX article (DOI to be added on publication).
